cases.findings: The reported clinical indication is persistent cough. The trachea and main bronchi are patent. No pathologic lymph node is detected in the mediastinum. The heart and mediastinal vascular structures are unremarkable, and the esophagus is within normal limits. No pleural effusion or pleural thickening is present in either hemithorax. Both lungs demonstrate bilateral patchy ground-glass densities, crazy-paving appearances, and consolidations in a peripheral (subpleural) distribution. Cylindrical bronchiectasis and vascular enlargement are present in the affected pulmonary regions. In the reported clinical setting of persistent cough (the examination indication), I consider this pattern potentially compatible with viral pneumonia; the appearances include findings described as classic or probable for coronavirus disease 2019. Other infectious agents (influenza, parainfluenza, and mycoplasma) and other organizing pneumonias (such as those associated with drug toxicity or connective tissue disease) may produce similar appearances and remain differential considerations. In the imaged upper abdomen, the bilateral adrenal glands are unremarkable, and no significant pathology is detected. Degenerative osteophytes are present at the vertebral body corners.
